name: Kaiming Liu
research_statement: My research centers on the human experience of AI agents: understanding what people need, reducing the effort of collaboration, and delivering outcomes that are useful in practice. I study outcome alignment, shared understanding in collaboration, and reliable interaction with tools and environments. My goal is to build agents that fit naturally into people's work.

publications.title: Instructions Are Evidence, Not Objectives: Measuring Outcome Alignment of Agents
publications.description: Can agents infer missing requirements and deliver the outcome a person actually needs?

publications.title: Illusion of Alignment: Detecting Hidden Disagreement in Collaborative Dialogue
publications.description: Surfacing hidden disagreements when a conversation appears to end in agreement.

publications.title: Agent-Environment Alignment via Automated Interface Generation
publications.description: Automatically generating interfaces that help agents understand and act in their environments.

publications.title: AIGS: Generating Science from AI-Powered Automated Falsification
publications.description: A multi-agent research system that puts scientific hypotheses to the test through falsification.
